title: chekist57
description:
-Are you gangsters? 
-No, we're Russians
|Dialogue from the movie Brother 2 (2000)|
body:
This resource pack is about Russia in the wild 90s.

Largely inspired by the film Brother 2 (2000).

Optimized primarily for Bedwars.

Will be updated and expanded in the future.

Changes the following textures:

1)Arrows (all types) - texture changed to shotgun shells as an item, and as a bullet when they fly or hit the ground (model).

2)Bow - changes to a shotgun (even when drawn).

3)Bow shot sound - replaced with a rifle shot.

4)Fireball - replaced with a grenade texture.

5)Totem of Immortality - replaced with an FSB ID.

6)Stick - replaced with a police baton.

7)Golden Apple - replaced with beer.

8)Blaze Rod - replaced with a cigarette.

9)Blaze Powder - replaced with Lighter

10)Magma Clump - replaced with a walkie-talkie

11)Fireworks - replaced with a different rocket texture

12)Potions - replaced with glass and shot glass textures

13)Gray and Lime Dyes - replaced with a Makarov pistol

14)Dynamite - replaced with a nuclear bomb texture

15)Health textures - replaced with shoulder straps

16)Hunger textures - replaced with dollar textures

17)When combined with shaders, the shield window becomes transparent

This resource pack does not intend to offend anyone, but rather attempts to convey the spirit of an era when the streets were mired in violence and the security forces were corrupt...

And this resource pack is a sarcastic way to convey the message of intolerance for corruption and banditry.
